title: Practice: Much, many, few, how many, several

blocks.text: Exercises: sentences and translations from Tatoeba (tatoeba.org, CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: Температура несколько ___ (день, gen. pl.) была минусовая.
exercises.prompt: The temperature was below freezing for several days.
exercises.why: The genitive case has four main uses: to denote possession ('Michael's car', meaning 'the car of Michael'), to denote number ('five apples'), in negative constructions ('there are no books'), and after several important prepositions ('without me'). — From the Wikibooks Russian textbook (CC BY-SA 4.0). From the DLI Grammar Reference Book. Lesson 23.
exercises.context: The genitive case has four main uses: to denote possession ('Michael's car', meaning 'the car of Michael'), to denote number ('five apples'), in negative constructions ('there are no books'), and after several important prepositions ('without me').

exercises.q: Сколько ___ (приседание, gen. pl.) ты можешь сделать?
exercises.prompt: How many squats can you do?
exercises.why: Such phrases as above are used in the following "NEUTER" constructions: *У меня мало времени. У меня было много уроков. Сколько у вас было учебников? Нам нужно будет много бумаги.* *Сколько учебников у вас было? — У нас было несколько учебников. Сколько механиков вам нужно будет? — Нам нужно будет несколько механиков.* — DLI, Lesson 38.
